definitionZh: rx CSS属性定义了一个SVG的x轴,或水平,半径以及一个SVG矩形的角的横向曲线. 如果存在,它会超越形状的属性.
sourceDefinition: The rx CSS property defines the x-axis, or horizontal, radius of an SVG and the horizontal curve of the corners of an SVG rectangle. If present, it overrides the shape's attribute.
